app_fee.quote: A fee of $110 CDN (for students with Canadian transcripts) or $150 CDN (for students with international transcripts) will apply.

english_waiver.value: Exempt only if BOTH: degree taught and examined in English AND institution in an English-primary country (list linked); otherwise submit scores
english_waiver.quote: International applicants are exempt from providing English test scores if both of the following conditions are met: They have completed a post-secondary degree at an institution where the language of instruction and examination was in English. That the institution was located in a country where English is the primary language (including Canada).

notes: PhD starts possible in September, January or May.
